newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Taiwan buys 360,000/T '97 naphtha at plus $3.40-50.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan buys 360,000/T '97 naphtha at plus $3.40-50.

text.p: Taiwan's state-owned Chinese Petroleum Corp (CPC) has concluded a term contract to buy up to 360,000 tonnes of naphthenic and aromatic (N+A) naphtha for 1997 at $3.40-$3.50 a tonne over Singapore quotes, cost-and-freight (c-and-f) Kaohsiung, a CPC official said on Thursday.
The official said CPC may conclude another contract. "So far there is only this one," the official said. "But we are considering another."
The tender which closed on November 18, sought up to 25,000-30,000 tonnes of N+A a month, a quarter or bi-monthly.
The official said CPC was pleased that the contract was concluded at a lower price than the term premium for 1996 of $3.75 a tonne to Singapore spot quotes, c-and-f for up to two cargoes a month.
